summary: Preguntas frecuentes de Schema.org (V30.1). Confirma que marcar solo algunas propiedades está bien (no hay propiedades obligatorias), que valen los espacios de nombres http y https, y fija que solo se marque el contenido visible.

quotes.text: It is fine to mark up only some properties of an item - markup is not an all-or-nothing choice.
As a general rule, you should mark up only the content that is visible to people who visit the web page and not content in hidden div's or other hidden page elements.
This is a lengthy way of saying that both 'https://schema.org' and 'http://schema.org' are fine.
